attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in his own post, asserted as fact rather than quoted from someone else.

semantics.note: The revised proposition matches the sentence: a past-tense observation that Nadella publicly acknowledged diminishing returns, with no added scope.

contract.note: The plain reading (Nadella accepted smaller gains from scaling, not just that there was a debate) is an ordinary reading of 'acknowledging diminishing returns'. It also fairly requires the referenced remarks to be identified before the claim can be contradicted.

evidence.note: Nadella's dated Nov 20, 2024 post acknowledges a debate about hitting the wall and calls scaling laws empirical observations. It does not accept diminishing returns, and it may not be the remark Marcus meant.

Official Ignite transcript from Nov 19, 2024. It welcomes skepticism and debate, claims performance doubling about every six months and points to a new test-time scaling law. That is not an acknowledgment, but it doesn't rule out other remarks.

reviews.rationale: The located Ignite remarks only acknowledge a debate, which the contract says is not enough for support. But the post doesn't identify which remarks Marcus meant, so the contradiction condition (identify them and show Nadella said no such thing) isn't met. The packet settles neither side, so the claim is unresolved.
